newsitem.title: USA: Republicans win Alabama Democratic Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Republicans win Alabama Democratic Senate seat.

text.p: Republican Jeff Sessions defeated Democrat Roger Bedford for the open Democratic Senate seat in Alabama, television networks projected on Tuesday.

The Alabama seat was one of four in the South -- also including Louisiana, Arkansas and Georgia -- where Democratic incumbent senators retired, giving Republicans a chance. The victory in Alabama will make it harder for Democrats to win a majority in the Senate, where Republicans held a 53-47 majority.
